questions.question: What was the total number of infant deaths recorded in Maryland in 2012?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
val = df.loc[df['Year'] == 2012, 'Infant Deaths (Total)'].values[0]
result = int(val)

questions.question: In which year did Maryland record its lowest overall infant mortality rate?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
min_year = df.loc[df['Infant Mortality Rate (Total)'].idxmin(), 'Year']
result = str(int(min_year))

questions.question: From 2000 through 2015, were there any years where the total number of infant deaths exceeded 700?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] >= 2000) & (df['Year'] <= 2015)]
result = 'yes' if (sub['Infant Deaths (Total)'] > 700).any() else 'no'

questions.question: Between 1919 and 2015, which demographic group suffered more cumulative infant deaths overall, White infants or Black infants?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] >= 1919) & (df['Year'] <= 2015)]
white_deaths = sub['Infant Deaths (White)'].sum()
black_deaths = sub['Infant Deaths (Black)'].sum()
result = 'White' if white_deaths > black_deaths else 'Black'

questions.question: How many infant deaths among Black babies were recorded in total across the five years from 2010 to 2014?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
sub = df[(df['Year'] >= 2010) & (df['Year'] <= 2014)]
result = int(sub['Infant Deaths (Black)'].sum())

questions.question: What were the three years with the highest overall infant mortality rates recorded in the dataset?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('md_infant_deaths_and_rates.csv')
top3 = df.sort_values(by='Infant Mortality Rate (Total)', ascending=False).head(3)['Year'].tolist()
result = [str(int(y)) for y in top3]
